verdicts_or_reports.expected: On a fresh list with no direction chosen, Sorting "By due date" shows Ascending, matching the list. In the list, Buy milk (Nov 19) came before Pack for trip (Nov 24) before Pay rent (Dec 4).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: On first open, the sort sheet showed Sorting "By due date" with "Descending", but the list was in ascending due-date order. When I tapped the toggle, it changed to Ascending.
steps: Open My Tasks on the fresh build without changing any sort settings
Tap Sort in the bottom bar
Read the Sorting row: it says By due date, Descending, while the list is in ascending order

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: I filed one bug: on first open the sort sheet showed Sorting "By due date" as Descending, while the list was in ascending order. The developer confirmed it. I checked the subtask badge, search, and grouping by due date, start date, created and last modified. I found no other defects. I could not exercise the scheduled-date grouping rules. None of the seed tasks has a start date, so every task landed in "No start date". Grouping by Created and by last modified put every task under "No date", which I assumed was a seed-data effect and did not report.
